divergence: All three runs failed the same way. Store-wide scans and listings reached every qualifying matter, then each run read a hand-picked set of executed agreements, so the first error in all three is surfaced-not-opened at the first screening reads (two matters in T0, seven in T1, nine in T2); the more matters a run read, the more criteria it passed (22, 20, 17). All three also stated the rate over the signed deals they had confirmed (100%) rather than over the practice's matters, and counted one or two sibling or membership-interest deals outside the set. Reviews flagged the hand-picked lists in every run (by number range in T1); the agents widened snippet scripts but not their reading lists.
